title: Away Afternoon
text:
Wednesday 21 October 2026 · 13:00–15:00
This year, no lightning talks. Instead: a map of how we all move through Liverpool, some quick conversations, and a world café to find out what we each work on, struggle with, and could teach each other.

title: Away Afternoon
text:
Programme



13:00 – 13:05



Welcome & Our Liverpool


We open with the map of everyone’s routes and photos.





13:05 – 13:15



Line-up


Line up by the length of your route, shortest to longest, then count off 1–4. That’s your group for the afternoon.





13:15 – 13:30



Quick pairs


Three 4-minute chats within your group. Prompt: tell me about the photo on your route.





13:30 – 14:35



World café


Four tables (Data, Place, Method, Problem), about 15 minutes each. Groups rotate; hosts stay put. Ideas go straight onto the Padlet.





14:35 – 15:00



Harvest & pitches


Each host pitches their table’s highlights (about 4 minutes) with the Padlet on screen. We vote on the Problem board, then close with the map.
